conflicts.claim_b: $125M Series G in April 2021 (per PRNewswire, Inc42, PitchBook)
conflicts.resolution: The $125M Series G figure is well-documented across multiple primary sources; the $50M claim is not corroborated.

conflicts.claim_b: $250M Series H in February 2022 (per Insight Partners, Reuters, CB Insights)
conflicts.resolution: The $250M Series H figure is well-documented; the $60M claim is not corroborated.

conflicts.claim_b: $1.4B post-money (Series G, April 2021) and $3.5B post-money (Series H, Feb 2022)
conflicts.resolution: The $1.3B figure does not match any documented valuation. Series G was $1.4B; Series H was $3.5B.

conflicts.claim_b: Bengaluru mentioned as office location; US HQ in North Bethesda
conflicts.resolution: Chennai is the registered office and primary India hub; Bengaluru is a secondary office. The company is dual US-India.
conflicts.resolved_value: Chennai (India registered office); North Bethesda MD (US HQ); Bengaluru (office)
